purpose: Independent normal-opening development replication of the previously trained immediate-action student; no fit, selection or exposure to the new maps before registration. The old two-map development readout stays separate.
examiner: Original repository package from normal opening, both physical seats, the original adaptive 0.58s search and native unseeded T=1 orders, official termination and extinction scoring, no teacher injection or relabelling.
execution: One physical seed-seat per hosted job, two cold starts on the same CPU set and host in the listed balanced order. Independent disconnected Python 3.12 / NumPy 1.26.4 Docker containers at 1.5 CPU / 512 MiB per agent. Count complete public request and parsed reply including turn zero; report both sides, init <=20s, base 1s, hard 3s, <=3 slow per party/game, <=5s cumulative excess, whole match <=1500s. Read back cgroups and report original actual depth, candidate count and deadlines.

estimands.absolute: Each arm 8 registered games; record both seats, W/D/L, observed wins over 8, and mean signed official terminal score difference. Draws are never wins. Report timeout forfeits and missing official numerical scores separately without fabricating a margin.
estimands.paired: Within each seed and physical seat compare BC minus parent for signed official margin and binary win indication. Average both seats equally within each of 4 physical maps and all maps equally across the batch. Return individual map changes and map-clustered two-sided 95% t interval (df=3) and exhaustively enumerate 4^4 whole-map bootstrap resamples for percentile sensitivity. Report only when all needed outcomes are available. Four maps may yield wide or degenerate intervals.
estimands.history: Previous development results, formal examination, training games and additional runs stay out of this batch. No selection/early stopping based on result, elapsed depth, physical seat or clock. Retain every missing ticket and timeout, never replace a game.
